title: 20.0% efficiency of ternary organic solar cells enabled by a novel wide band gap polymer guest donor
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05848H, Paper
Junkang Zhou, Xinjie Zhou, Hongge Jia, Lijun Tu, Siqi Wu, Xiaomin Xia, Xin Song, Yongqiang Shi
A novel wide bandgap polymer donor, P(BTzE-BDT), was synthesized and incorporated into the PM6:BTP-eC9 system to fabricate ternary OSCs, achieving a higher power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 20.0%.
